title: Chromascope: an open-source LC-MS workbench
description: Chromascope is a free, open-source LC-MS workbench written in Rust. It opens mzML data, draws chromatograms and spectra, integrates peaks, builds calibration curves and runs quantification and QC, as a desktop app, a JSON command-line tool, or over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for AI assistants. Results keep their units, settings, software versions and source hashes.
